newsitem.title: UK: Euro straight-run fuel scarce and expensive.
newsitem.headline: Euro straight-run fuel scarce and expensive.

text.p: European straight-run fuel was strongly valued on Monday with little available and refiners still greedy for the product, traders said.
Last Friday's deal at $109.25 a tonne set a new price benchmark, and other cargo holders were expected to ask similar amounts for next avails, which are not for at least three weeks.
One ARA refiner was not yet offering his 0.8 percent material, though market sources put its price at $109 a tonne.
"There's been a shortage of straight-run in Europe over the last 4-6 weeks," said one trader. "Cracking margins have remained good while refining margins have been poor."
